item.title: mokevnin/dev-quality-gates: An opinionated, curated list of tools for enforcing software development standards: one recommended tool per…

item.description: The Japanese yen surged to 156.81 per US dollar on Oct 23 as a global flight to safety followed weak tech and AI earnings and Middle East tensions. The yen also hit a one-year high against the euro. Why it matters: Safe-haven currency moves and market volatility matter to investors, especially those following Singapore markets.

item.title: From oil rigs to offshore wind: Singapore yards chase Europe’s energy-transition business
item.description: Singapore shipyards are repurposing decades of offshore oil and gas expertise for Europe's offshore wind push. A 30,000-tonne converter platform from Seatrium is due to leave for the North Sea in 2028. Why it matters: Shows Singapore's energy-sector expertise being redirected toward renewables, relevant to markets and Southeast Asia readers.

Why it matters: Most of Singapore's electricity is generated with natural gas, and much of that gas comes by pipeline from Indonesia.

Why it matters: China is the world's second-largest equities market, so the slide matters for global investors and markets.

item.title: rossark0/rossark-motion-skill: Turn any SVG into a professional 60 fps animation. A Claude Code skill that brings anything drawn to life…

It aims to make drawings feel alive, with breathing, blinking and smooth motion. Why it matters: Agents often animate stiffly; this skill targets the timing that makes motion feel alive, for apps and design work.

Why it matters: Self-hosted alternative to Buffer and Opus Clip with no monthly bill; you pay AI providers directly.
